d: Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin. Three powerful leaders, one room and a long list of issues that could shape the global order. As Trump arrives in China, Xi rolls out the red carpet. Putin is already there. The three leaders are expected to hold an unprecedented trilateral meeting on the sidelines of the APEC summit. Trade, tariffs, AI chips, nuclear weapons, Iran and Ukraine are all potential talking points. What does each leader want from this meeting? And who stands to gain the most? Palki Sharma breaks down the high-stakes power play in China.
